{
 "path": "programs/task-2b862c63.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Restore the blank rectangular patch by reflecting its contents across
    # the horizontal center line of the 24x24 patterned grid.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    zeros = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    if not zeros:
        return out
    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in zeros), max(r for r,c in zeros)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in zeros), max(c for r,c in zeros)
    for r in range(r0, r1+1):
        for c in range(c0, c1+1):
            out[r][c] = grid[h-1-r][c]
    return out
"
}
